subject.title: [Bug]: Live Docs are ahead of release

question: Should OpenClaw solve live-docs/release drift with version-gated public docs, version-aware config diagnostics, a release-docs gate, or by delegating the broader agent-local docs direction to the separate version-matched docs issue?
rationale: The recurring bug is real, but the durable fix changes docs publishing and release policy rather than one schema or docs page.

options.title: Gate latest docs by release availability
options.body: Add version metadata or release checks so public docs do not advertise strict config keys before a stable release accepts them.

options.title: Add version-aware config diagnostics
options.body: Teach validation or doctor to recognize known future keys and point users to the required release when docs have moved ahead.

options.title: Track only bundled docs retrieval
options.body: Route the broader native docs knowledge-layer work to https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/71301 while this issue covers immediate live-docs release gating.

recommendation.title: Gate latest docs by release availability
recommendation.body: Add version metadata or release checks so public docs do not advertise strict config keys before a stable release accepts them.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history ties vincentkoc to the config/docs change that currently demonstrates the drift and to release-adjacent maintainer validation comments on that PR.
